Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.report

Class AbstractReportGenerator<D>

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.report.AbstractReportGenerator<D>
Type Parameters:
D - the type of document being built
All Implemented Interfaces:
ReportGenerator
Direct Known Subclasses:
JsonReportGenerator, PdfReportGenerator
public abstract class AbstractReportGenerator<D> extends Object implements ReportGenerator
The abstract class of the Template Method pattern. Its final generate method fixes the steps every report follows, and the subclasses fill in the steps that differ.
Author:
Reinaldo Singh

  • Method Details

    • generate

      public final Path generate(TelemetrySession session, long endMillis, Path target) throws IOException
      The template method. It calculates the statistics, builds the document with createDocument, addSummary, addDetails and addFooter, saves it to a temporary file, and moves it into place, so a half-written report is never left behind.
      Specified by:
      generate in interface ReportGenerator
      Parameters:
      session - the session being reported on
      endMillis - the end time of the session in epoch milliseconds
      target - where the report should be written
      Returns:
      the file that was written
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read or written
